summary: Office Properties Income Trust filed an 8-K covering a $425.0 million offering of 8.75% senior secured notes due October 1, 2031, issued September 24, 2026. The notes are guaranteed by subsidiaries and secured by first-priority liens on 19 office properties plus 100% of subsidiary equity, ranking senior to the company's 10.000% secured notes under an intercreditor agreement. Net proceeds with cash on hand repaid all secured revolver and term loan borrowings. Interest pays semi-annually beginning April 1, 2027; make-whole redemption until October 1, 2028, then fixed call prices. This is a routine refinancing, not a special situation.
